page.layout: One page of text: title page, centred. Below the printer's device (engraving) the imprint lines. No running head, no page number. Marginal pencil marks at top left, top right and bottom right are not printed text.

main_text.l: LAELII, SIVE DE AMICITIA DIALOGI, AD
Vsus frequens omnium magistrorum praecepta superat.

page.notes: The printed text is set in roman capitals and italic; the initials "Vsus" in the motto and the "Per" line are as printed. Hand-written pencil or ink marks ("hil.", "0", "29.", "3Z") are handwriting and are left out. The engraving shows a small church with two towers and a central dome, with the device "B D" beneath it, and is described here rather than transcribed. The motto line "Vsus frequens..." appears with a decorative initial V; I have read it as "Vsus", which is uncertain, so it is marked below. The name "Su Ioh. Georgy à Werdenstein" is partly illegible in the scan and the spelling of the last word may be uncertain.
